about.title: About
about.featureDesc: Automatically detects Kingshot gift codes and redeems them right away for your registered player IDs.
about.howDesc: Enter your player ID and press Register. Codes will keep being redeemed automatically even after you close the site.
about.findIdDesc: Launch the game → Profile → Info tab. It's shown below your name.
about.kingdomDesc: The kingdom number you enter applies to every player ID entered above. Register players from different kingdoms separately.
about.noticeProfile: Nicknames and avatars come from publicly available external data, so updates may be delayed or not shown at all.
about.noticeTransfer: If you've transferred to another kingdom, register again with the same player ID and your new kingdom number, and your kingdom info will be updated automatically.
about.noticeInactive: Players who haven't logged into the game for a long time (90+ days) are detected automatically and auto-redeem is paused (deactivated). Register again to reactivate right away.
about.disclaimerText: To respect Kingshot server rate limits, all registrations and redemptions are processed through a queue.
about.disclaimerItem1: Initial registration and instant redemption may take a few minutes.
about.disclaimerItem2: When many users are registered, redeeming new codes may be delayed.
about.disclaimerItem3: If delays become excessive, improvements will be rolled out.
